notes: Direct HTTP (curl/curl_cffi chrome120), Playwright headless, and directly typing /homeware or /shop/... URLs into the browser all hit an Akamai Bot Manager interstitial ('Powered and protected by Akamai') that never resolved after 60+s of waiting. No Claude-specific robots.txt disallow exists, so per access-tier rules proceeded to Claude-in-Chrome; deep-linked category URLs reached via the homepage 'TRENDING CHRISTMAS' tile and in-page navigation (rather than typing bare /homeware or /shop/all/... into the address bar) loaded normally and returned real product grids with exact counts. All qty figures below are the site's own displayed '(N)' PLP header. Discovered via: homepage trending tiles, an older but still-live /homeware/christmas hub page (whose stale 2017-era productaffiliation-* links mostly 404'd except one which 301-redirected to the current live taxonomy), the live /shop/home/christmas-decorations and /shop/home/f/event-christmas category trees and their sidebar 'Shop By Category'/related-category links, and direct event-<holiday> facet probes (event-halloween, event-valentines, event-easter, event-mothersday, event-fathersday, event-diwali, event-newyear, event-thanksgiving not tested/UK site) under /shop/home/. event-newyear returned a genuine 0-result page (dropped, not proof of a general absence issue). /christmas is a pure cross-department marketing hub (no product grid/qty) and was excluded. /shop/all/f/event-christmas and similar /shop/all/... facets were excluded as out of Homeware scope (span all Next departments). Two facet pages nested under christmas-decorations were excluded as pure duplicate aggregates of already-captured leaves: 'Christmas Garlands & Wreaths' (119 = exact sum of Wreaths 64 + Garlands 55) and the broad type=stocking filter (49, overlaps/duplicates the narrower Stockings And Sacks leaf of 3). 'Christmas Decorations' (1135) is a genuine grouping parent: its children sum EXACTLY to 1135 (558+188+184+64+55+29+22+19+4+3+9=1135), so it is recorded as a null-qty grouping row per the shared parent/child rule; two of those exact-sum children ('Christmas Home Decorations' 19 and 'Christmas Outdoor Lighting' 9) are flagged MANUAL REVIEW because their sampled product grids showed generic/mixed-occasion items (Halloween wreath, autumnal wreath, generic solar garden lights) despite being counted inside the Christmas Decorations total. 'Christmas At Home' (1668) does NOT equal the sum of its own listed children (~1821, indicating cross-facet overlap rather than a clean partition), so it is kept as its own genuine leaf row with its real qty rather than nulled. Pumpkin Homeware (187) is a pattern=pumpkin filter spanning Halloween and general Autumn decor, kept under Halloween (its discovery path) but flagged. Father's Day Homeware (379) sample included some non-homeware gift items (baby bibs); flagged rather than excluded since the site itself counts them under this Home-department event filter. Room/vocabulary words (Home, Kitchen, Bedding) were kept per Rule 0 - Seasonal PLPs coexist with Kitchen&Dining/Textile/Bedding rather than being excluded for overlapping another category (rules sec 7). ADJUDICATION (2026-09-04): removed the 'Pumpkin Homeware' row (pattern=pumpkin filter, /shop/home/f/pattern-pumpkin) - the site's own related links confirm this pattern-attribute filter spans both Halloween and general Autumn decor rather than naming a genuine Halloween-specific category, matching the filter/attribute-only exclusion rule rather than a true holiday category.
